data.title: 白金 · 游乐园的回眸浅笑
data.description: 【卡西米尔主题乐园·黄昏】旋转木马的金色灯带在薄暮中次第亮起，白金一只手拿着印有天马图案的草莓可丽饼，另一只手轻轻拉住身侧同行者的衣角，难得露出毫无防备的温柔微笑：“博士，说好了今天不谈公事。”
data.location: 卡西米尔主题乐园旋转木马前
data.action: 手持可丽饼回首牵衣角微笑
data.lighting: 旋转木马金色暖光灯带与暮色晚霞
data.camera: 平视半身特写，背景暖色光斑虚化
data.promptProse: At an amusement park during dusk, warm golden lights illuminate a vintage merry-go-round in the soft blurred background. Platinum holds a sweet strawberry crepe wrapped in decorative paper, turning around with a gentle relaxed smile. Her long silver hair catches the twilight reflections, looking affectionately at the viewer.
